notes: Each row serves a sourced value for one upstream fact on current catalog reads, in place of the value models.dev publishes. A row applies only while the stored upstream value equals its `replaces` exactly: when models.dev moves to any other value the row stops applying and the upstream value is served, so an override can never hide a later upstream change. Nothing here is stored, and point-in-time (`at_ms`) reads serve the recorded value. Every applied row is disclosed in the response's `fact_overrides` list. Only limit.context and limit.output may be overridden.

overrides.reason: models.dev records 32,768, which is Google's cap for a non-streaming request. A streaming request returns up to 65,536 tokens, so a consumer that streams and caps output at the catalog value would stop every answer at half the length the model can produce.
overrides.quote: Model page: "Max output 65,536 (default synchronous) / up to 1,048,576 (with long decode)". Latest-model guide: "One streaming request returns up to 65,536 tokens. One non-streaming request returns up to 32,768 tokens, down from 65,536 on Gemini 3.x."
overrides.notes: models.dev changed this value from 65,536 to 32,768 at fusiform's 2026-10-13 17:01Z poll. The Antigravity route google/antigravity-gemini-4-argon, a curated alias of this row (model-aliases.json), serves the same value because alias entries are built from the target's served facts; the plugin declares that route as limit: { context: 1048576, output: 65536 } in https://github.com/cortexkit/antigravity-auth/blob/48919aa7ae9378ea19af17e7d9da5b986395f00a/packages/core/src/model-registry.ts.
